# Yousuf Khan, senior software engineer

Yousuf Khan is a senior software engineer based in Bremen, Germany. He has worked professionally in software since 2016 and currently works at Kuehne+Nagel. His experience includes logistics, healthcare, telecommunications, banking, and e-commerce systems.

## Technical focus

Backend: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Laravel, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Kafka, and Mockito.

Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Next.js, TanStack Start, and Jest.

Delivery and infrastructure: Git, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.

## Work history

- Kuehne+Nagel, Senior Software Engineer, July 2022 to present, Hamburg, Germany. Work includes shipment monitoring and an event-driven Spring Boot, Kafka, and Angular system for air logistics operations.
- Method Park by UL, Software Engineer, August 2019 to July 2022, Erlangen, Germany. Work included an Angular platform that helped orthopedic surgeons review AI-assisted X-ray reports.
- InfancyIT, Software Engineer, October 2017 to April 2019, Sylhet, Bangladesh. Work included API and full-stack development for a food delivery platform.
- Vivacom Solutions Ltd, Software Engineer, October 2016 to September 2017, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Work included a telecommunications content management system and Spring Boot services for mobile banking.

## Education

- M.Sc. Software System Science, Otto-Friedrich-Universitat Bamberg, 2022.
- Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering, Shahjalal University of Science and Technology, 2015.
